entries.title: Psalms 12:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. On an eight-stringed harp. A Psalm of David.>> Help, LORD, for the godly man ceases! For the faithful disappear from among the sons of men.

entries.title: Psalms 12:2
segments: They speak idly everyone with his neighbor; [With] flattering lips [and] a double heart they speak.

entries.title: Psalms 12:3
segments: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, [And] the tongue that speaks proud things,

entries.title: Psalms 12:4
segments: Who have said, "With our tongue we will prevail; Our lips [are] our own; Who [is] lord over us?"

entries.title: Psalms 12:5
segments: "For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, Now I will arise," says the LORD; "I will set [him] in the safety for which he yearns."

entries.title: Psalms 12:6
segments: The words of the LORD [are] pure words, [Like] silver tried in a furnace of earth, Purified seven times.

entries.title: Psalms 12:7
segments: You shall keep them, O LORD, You shall preserve them from this generation forever.

entries.title: Psalms 12:8
segments: The wicked prowl on every side, When vileness is exalted among the sons of men.
